practical_scenarios.situation: A prospect says a missing feature is mandatory, and the seller asks you to describe a manual workaround as native capability.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: State the gap accurately, validate whether the workaround is acceptable and supportable, document effort and risk, and escalate the no-bid or exception decision rather than changing the meaning of the requirement.

practical_scenarios.title: Late security review
practical_scenarios.situation: Security review begins after pricing approval and discovers a data-residency requirement that the proposed design may not meet.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Pause commitment, trace all data locations, engage security, privacy and legal owners, present supported architecture options and rebaseline commercial timing using evidence.

practical_scenarios.title: Executive demo outage
practical_scenarios.situation: The main demo environment becomes unavailable while the customer executive team is waiting.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Acknowledge the interruption briefly, switch to the rehearsed fallback, preserve the business narrative and agree any follow-up validation without pretending the failure did not occur.

practical_scenarios.title: POC scope explosion
practical_scenarios.situation: A two-week POC has accumulated three new integrations and an additional business unit, but the end date is unchanged.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Return to the decision hypothesis, quantify impact, apply scope change control, trade additions for removals or create a later phase and obtain sponsor agreement.

practical_scenarios.title: Conflicting stakeholder success criteria
practical_scenarios.situation: Operations wants reliability, finance wants lowest cost and the business sponsor wants launch within one month.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Make the conflict explicit, quantify the trade-offs, identify nonnegotiable constraints and obtain a prioritized decision from accountable sponsors with residual risk recorded.

practical_scenarios.title: Integration latency surprise
practical_scenarios.situation: A proof test reveals that an external customer API causes the end-to-end workflow to miss the target latency.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Separate internal and external timing, verify representative conditions, explore async or caching options, update the architecture and value impact and report the POC result against the agreed criterion.

practical_scenarios.title: No active customer champion
practical_scenarios.situation: The original champion leaves during onboarding and other users do not understand why the product was purchased.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Rebuild stakeholder alignment, identify an accountable sponsor and operational champion, restate outcomes and first value, and rebaseline adoption rather than continuing task execution without ownership.

source.title: Focus Your Strategic Efforts with Sales Account Plans

practical_scenarios.title: Request for an absolute compliance guarantee
practical_scenarios.situation: Procurement asks you to certify that the product guarantees the customer will comply with all applicable regulations.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Explain that platform controls support but do not guarantee customer compliance, describe the shared-responsibility boundary, provide approved evidence and route legal language to qualified owners.

practical_scenarios.title: Overpromised implementation date
practical_scenarios.situation: A signed order contains a date that delivery says is impossible because a customer dependency was omitted.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Escalate immediately, identify the commitment source, quantify options and impact, align on a corrected joint plan and communicate factually with the customer while improving approval controls.

practical_scenarios.title: Low adoption after successful launch
practical_scenarios.situation: The service is stable and users were trained, but the priority workflow is rarely completed.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Use telemetry and user observation to test fit, permissions, data and process barriers, form a targeted intervention and measure workflow completion and outcome rather than sending generic reminders.

practical_scenarios.title: Misleading health score
practical_scenarios.situation: A strategic customer appears healthy because of high usage, but support escalations and sponsor sentiment are worsening.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Review the account manually, add relationship and support signals, document any override, validate the model against renewal outcomes and ensure the score drives concrete action.

practical_scenarios.title: Incident before a QBR
practical_scenarios.situation: A major service incident begins the day before an executive business review.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Prioritize incident response, separate live status from root-cause discussion, decide whether to reschedule the QBR and prepare an honest executive update with mitigation, impact and follow-up commitments.

practical_scenarios.title: Renewal threatened by missing value evidence
practical_scenarios.situation: The customer questions renewal because the team can show usage but not the business outcome promised at sale.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Reconstruct the baseline and intended KPI, acknowledge the evidence gap, test current outcome with the customer and create a recovery or scope decision instead of equating activity with value.

practical_scenarios.title: Expansion during unresolved core issues
practical_scenarios.situation: A large add-on opportunity appears while the core deployment has open reliability problems.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Assess whether the add-on solves or compounds the issue, stabilize the core service and customer trust, and proceed only when the expansion has independent value and credible operational readiness.

practical_scenarios.title: Cross-border telemetry conflict
practical_scenarios.situation: The customer approved regional storage but later learns that diagnostic telemetry is processed globally.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Trace the telemetry data and purpose, engage privacy and contract owners, determine configurable options, disclose the actual flow and agree remediation or an explicit gap.

practical_scenarios.title: AI-generated false claim in proposal
practical_scenarios.situation: An AI assistant drafts a response saying the product has a certification it does not possess, and the text reaches final review.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Remove the claim, verify all AI-generated statements against approved sources, assess whether any customer received it and strengthen retrieval, review and accountability controls.

practical_scenarios.title: Partner ownership conflict
practical_scenarios.situation: A channel partner and direct team both claim solution authority and send inconsistent technical answers.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Assign one accountable solution lead, reconcile requirements and evidence, define partner roles and communication, then issue one corrected answer to the customer.

practical_scenarios.title: Discount requested despite poor fit
practical_scenarios.situation: Leadership asks for a large discount to close an opportunity whose mandatory integration remains unsupported.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Explain that discount does not resolve technical fit, quantify the gap and alternative, recommend scope change or disqualification and document the decision risk.
